frozen_issue.title: 逐帧保证未区分显式分帧输入与原生动画宿主位图
frozen_issue.legal_premises: Non-egg SPINDA, chosen normal shininess and valid front/back resource, adequate bitmap dimensions, unchanged handlers. Two-frame native/GIF resources also satisfy the candidate SP07 wording; candidate does not restrict to explicit frame enumeration.
frozen_issue.normal_static_positive: For a valid filename-encoded two-frame PNG, source creates two separate frame bitmaps, independently copies and enumerates them. With one-hit block and ordinary shininess false, original triples200/200/200 and100/100/100 derive200/85/125 and100/0/25.
frozen_issue.minimum_counterexample: A two-frame native/GIF resource is represented by one host bitmap. Script enumeration hands that single bitmap to the modifier once, without iterating native frame indices. Fixed Ruby evidence therefore cannot uniquely derive SP07 two independent per-native-frame outputs.

source_evidence.behavior: Individual sprite input copies then requests modifier for every bitmap supplied by the animation wrapper.
Filename-encoded PNG builds/iterates separate frames; native/GIF branch can report multiple frames but enumeration supplies one host bitmap, and copy duplicates that bitmap object.

frozen_issue.impact: Reference-fact prose would require all native animation frames to receive independent per-frame modifications, although the bounded source only proves one host-bitmap modifier request and leaves native get/set coverage unknown.
frozen_issue.requested_fix: Qualify WP21 overview101 and boundary157 to one modification per enumerated frame bitmap. State the proved explicit-frame PNG case without imposing source architecture. Specify that SP07 uses an explicitly enumerated two-frame PNG fixture. Add a finite native/GIF reverse static record: one host bitmap modification request, native frame get/set and displayed coverage unknown. Align traceability-proposal note50 and cite AnimatedBitmap evidence.
frozen_issue.fix_acceptance: All three candidate/proposal locations agree on the two branches; PNG independent-frame mathematical triples remain determinate; native/GIF reverse has no invented first-frame-only, success, failure, clipping or rollback conclusion; all pixel/animation/game/reference executions stay NOT_EXECUTED with0 runs. No new materials or source changes required.
